scope: Add a serialized terminal-receipt persistence coordinator with exact candidate validation, append-at-most-once behavior, and mandatory authoritative post-append reread, without executor dispatch or runtime mutation.

implemented.coordinator: packages/dicebox-compiler/src/staged-inverse-receipt-ledger.ts adds createStagedInverseReceiptStore() with serialized persistTerminalReceipt() orchestration.
implemented.preRead: The coordinator validates request, manifest, permit, claim, canonical candidate hash, deterministic receipt identity, exact operation, and operation-specific reread before any store access; an exact existing receipt is returned as persisted/not-attempted and a valid foreign entry becomes conflict/not-attempted.
implemented.appendReread: A missing receipt is appended at most once, and exactly one authoritative post-append reread is performed after both successful and uncertain append outcomes.
implemented.resolution: Persistence now distinguishes persisted, missing, unknown, and conflict outcomes, with separate candidateReceiptSha256 and observedReceiptSha256 fields; unknown is reread-required and no state is auto-retried.
implemented.preservation: Valid foreign entries are returned as preserved conflict evidence; malformed or unreadable storage is outcome-unknown; no overwrite, adapter call, Foundry action, or runtime mutation is reachable.

validation.focused: 6 files / 25 tests passed across receipt persistence, ledger, pre-dispatch context, preflight orchestration, executor boundary, adapter readback, and claim reread contracts.
validation.fullGate: npm run check:full passed: workflow checker PASS (score 63; 10/16 gates), package and desktop builds passed, full Vitest passed 150 files / 767 tests, and tooling verification passed with no failures.
validation.databaseBeforeImplementation: M683 KB rebuild and read-only queries passed at 1104 sources / 944 facts / 811 decisions before implementation.
validation.workflowAfterImplementation: Active-slice checker remains PASS with Stage 11 proposal-approval-history as the only active stage and readyClaim false.

delegation: A hidden Sol Medium read-only architecture audit independently identified the missing serialized coordinator, exact hash-attested entry boundary, pre-read conflict handling, mandatory post-append reread, explicit missing state, and append-at-most-once rules. The worker changed no files, the Foreman reviewed its receipt, and it was closed after integration review.
selectedNext: M685 read-only reconciliation of terminal receipt persistence against the inverse executor boundary; keep dispatch, Foundry action, runtime mutation, and Stage 11 acceptance excluded.
